build_gmock_with_fbcode_builder: build gmock by calling fbcode_builder_spec with a builder that has add_option and cmake_install methods
configure_googletest_git_hash: configure the googletest git hash option to release-1.8.1 using builder.add_option in fbcode_builder_spec
set_cmake_defines_for_gtest: set cmake defines like BUILD_GTEST ON and BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF via builder.add_option
create_github_project_workdir: create a github project workdir for google/googletest using builder.github_project_workdir with build subdirectory
run_cmake_install_for_googletest: run cmake install for google/googletest using builder.cmake_install in the build steps list
